prompts.raspberry: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: transparent fruit explosion background for the center stage of a premium VKTRY energy drink website shop. Primary request: dramatic high speed flash photography of vivid ripe red raspberries, two raspberry halves with visible hollow centers, tiny raspberry drupelets exploding outward in a spectacular splash, suspended mid air. Square composition, an energetic diagonal circular burst around a LARGE EMPTY VERTICAL CENTRAL SPACE reserved for a silver drink can that will be composited later. Concentrate the fruit and crystal clear water splash on the left and right wings around the center, with a few pieces at top and bottom. The center 28 percent width, middle 70 percent height must remain mostly transparent. Detailed condensation, realistic juice, energetic liquid arcs and flying pieces, clean crisp edges, refined commercial drink advertising photography. Color palette: ruby red and deep raspberry pink. Isolated cutout on genuinely transparent background, NO background color, NO backdrop, NO floor or horizon, NO can or bottle, NO text, NO letters, NO labels, NO logos, NO border, NO watermark. Keep every large piece inside the canvas with breathing space. The result is an image asset, not a website mockup.
